programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Ree Drummond is raiding the pantry, whipping up four cupboard showstoppers. She is spicing up standbys with a lunch of fragrant chickpea curry with rice, then for sweet treats in a hurry, no-bake peanut butter bars.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Ree Drummond's father-in-law, Chuck, is spearheading a big fence fixing project on the ranch, so Ree's saying thank you by delivering him and his crew a rib-sticking Tex-Mex lunch.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Ree Drummond is knocking out hearty breakfast biscuits that her husband and son are coming to collect on their way to feed the cattle.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Ree Drummond is sharing four vibrant recipes to celebrate the colours of summer.

programme.title: Barefoot Contessa
programme.desc: Heading out overnight, Ina prepares a great supper and breakfast to keep Jeffrey well fed in her absence. Just as she suspects, he skips the main course - a beef stew - and goes straight for the ice cream.

programme.title: Barefoot Contessa
programme.desc: Ina's friend's daughter has been working hard at college, so Ina invites her and two friends over for some delicious home cooking, including gravlax and blueberry coffee cake muffins.

programme.title: The Great British Bake Off
programme.desc: The baker's bread making skills are tested with three increasingly complicated challenges over two days. They start with the signature bake, a free-form flavoured loaf that produces a variety of interesting results. The technical challenge is focaccia, which really separates the wheat from the chaff. Finally, a mammoth six-hour hour challenge requires the bakers to create a display bread basket.

programme.title: The Great British Bake Off
programme.desc: The bakers take on biscuits and these bite-sized, delicate delights prove too much for some. The remaining eight must impress legendary cookery writer Mary Berry and artisan baker Paul Hollywood with their interpretation of a classic biscuit. Who will crumble when it comes to judging and whose ginger nuts are too hot to handle?

programme.title: Hairy Bikers' Mediterranean Adventure
programme.desc: The Hairy Bikers go off the beaten track in search of authentic flavours of Italy, from simple, local ingredients to spicy n'duja pate and some of the best gelato to be found.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: Guy Fieri grabs gangster global grub from a Jamaican joint in Houston and a 24-hour burrito hot spot in Cancun, Mexico.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: Guy Fieri visits an all-female lineup that's rockin' the house in Houston and Orlando, Florida.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives

programme.title: Villages by the Sea
programme.desc: Archaeologist Ben Robinson explores Parkgate, on the estuary of the River Dee in Cheshire. Today the village is landlocked, cut off from the Dee and the Irish Sea due to the estuary's shifting silt. But 250 years ago, it was a bustling harbour and as Ben finds out from Dr Gillian O'Brian, Parkgate was a gateway for thousands of Irish immigrants from the 1620s onwards.

programme.title: DIY SOS
